meta.title: PrivacyCulture — Know thyself
meta.description: Know thyself. Most privacy teams don’t. Privacy Culture Platform is GDPR software for mid-market UK teams — living ROPA, DSARs, DPIAs, vendor risk, and shadow AI in one connected view.

hero.strapline: From clutter to clarity to control
hero.cta: Start here to take the journey from clutter to clarity →
hero.subline: Your privacy truth is scattered across too many tools — and too many assumptions.

lens.eyebrow: Come and see the view from here
lens.title: This is what solved looks like.
lens.body: Every data flow, vendor and risk on one interactive map. Day-to-day tasks sit with the teams who own the data, while full visibility and sign-off stay with you.

principles.title: You start seeing it in the first session
principles.body: Load your real data and the map builds in front of you. No configuration project, no months of setup before anything is visible.

principles.title: One map instead of a thousand rows
principles.body: Data flows, vendor ecosystem and risk all render as a single interactive view. Gaps show up as gaps, so you spot the problem instead of hunting for it.

principles.title: Everyone owns their part
principles.body: Tasks route to the leads in HR, Marketing and Product who already know that data best. You keep central control and see everything from one dashboard.
